{{Quote|On Yn, the Jedi had laid siege to an Imperial stronghold. Tulak Hord broke the siege single-handedly!|Khem Val|<ref name="Exultation" />}}
'''Yn''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Around [[5300 BBY]], Yn and [[Chabosh]] were conquered by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]]. At the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Yn was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].

==Description==
Yn was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CE" /><ref name="ORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]]<ref name="EA" /> [[Yn system/Legends|star system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> near the [[Fennesa system/Legends|Fennesa system]].<ref name="EA" /> During the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Yn was a [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a diminutive [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CE" />

==History==
Around [[5300 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORcite|type=codex|Force-walking}} establishes that [[Ergast]] attempted [[Tulak Hord's ritual]] 300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after [[Tulak Hord]] himself. Additionally, {{TORcite|type=codex|Monument to Lord Ergast}} states that [[Ergast]] was among the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who first permanently settled [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], which occurred in [[4980 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''. Thus, Hord's [[Battle of Chabosh|use]] of the ritual at [[Chabosh]], and by extension the battles of [[Yn]] and Chabosh, occurred around [[5300 BBY]].</ref> Lord of Hate [[Tulak Hord]], a mighty [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] with legendary [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] skills, waged war against the planets Yn and [[Chabosh]], whose conquest was remembered for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] afterward.<ref name="ORE" /> When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Yn|attacked]] a [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith]] stronghold on Yn<ref name="Exultation" /> Tulak Hord, his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Ortan Cela]], and their [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Shadow Killer]]s, [[Khem Val]] and [[Veshikk Urk]],<ref name="The Master's Apprentice">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Khem Val|The Master's Apprentice}}</ref> led an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] warriors to break the Jedi siege, eliminating them and the rebels who opposed the expansion of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Tomb">{{TORcite|type=codex|Tomb of Tulak Hord}}</ref> Urk and Val feasted on the [[Living Force/Legends|Force potential]] of their enemies, and Tulak Hord used a [[Tulak Hord's ritual|ritual]] to draw the strength of his enemies to himself in order to gain power and vitality.<ref name="Ritual">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Ritual of Tulak Hord}}</ref> After winning the battle, Hord led his armies to [[Battle of Chabosh (Sith Empire)|take]] Chabosh as well.<ref name="Exultation" /> As a result of both battles, over a thousand Jedi were devoured.<ref name="HO">{{HolonetOld|biographies|khem-val|Khem Val}}</ref>

[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later,<ref name="NR" /> Yn was a [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a diminutive [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species.<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CE" /> [[17 ABY/Legends|Thirteen years]] after the [[Battle of Endor|Battle of Endor]], it was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Wwebyls]].<ref name="NR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The object Yn was first mentioned in the novel ''[[The New Rebellion]]'',<ref name="NR" /> which was written by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]] and released in [[1996]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> In [[1998]],<ref name="San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives">{{ThisWeek|-BZX-WxjhFE|San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives, Brand New LEGO Art, and More!|sw_url=video/san-diego-comic-con-exclusives-brand-new-lego-art-and-more|date=2020-07-02}}</ref> an entry for Yn was added to the reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which revealed that it was a world.<ref name="SWE" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Yn system/Legends|Yn star system]] and the planet itself in grid square K-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
